:::: {.column width="40%"}
**"All the People in the World" — Our World in Data (2018)**

**Weaknesses:**

- 🕐 **Static** — frozen at 2018, no temporal view
- 🎨 **Color = continent only** — no meaningful data encoding
- ⚧ **No gender dimension** — treats population as one number
- 🗺️ **Visual clutter** — dense regions like Europe are unreadable
